# MusTech Group (MUSTECH GROUP PTE. LTD.)

> MusTech Group is a Singapore technology holding company (ACRA UEN: 202609163C) building privacy-first mobile applications and civic digital services for the Muslim community. One founder runs three live products, Saalihat, jenazah.sg, and TaraBase, using AI tools for drafting and testing and approving every release personally. The group also runs MusTech Jumpstart, a course for founders. None of our products carry third-party advertising, and we never sell personal data.

## Corporate Identity
- **Legal Entity:** MUSTECH GROUP PTE. LTD.
- **ACRA UEN:** 202609163C
- **Headquarters:** Singapore
- **Founder:** Taufiq Rashid (Data Analytics Lead across APAC at WPP Media, with prior roles at Google, LVMH (Sephora), and OCBC Bank; Academic Consultant at Singapore Management University (SMU), ESSEC Business School, University of Hong Kong (HKU), and City University of Hong Kong (CityU))
- **General & Partnership Enquiries:** admin@mustechgroup.com
- **Saalihat Support:** saalihat_support@mustechgroup.com

## Products

### 1. Saalihat (iOS & Android)
- **Summary:** Verified mosque lecture and community event directory for Singapore. Turns scattered posters and chat announcements into a searchable schedule. Speakers are checked against the Asatizah Recognition Scheme (ARS). No ads, and bookmarks stay on your phone.
- **iOS App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/sg/app/saalihat/id6760661366
- **Google Play Store:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mustechgroup.saalihat
- **Privacy Policy:** https://www.mustechgroup.com/privacy-policy
- **Walkthrough:** https://www.mustechgroup.com/portfolio#saalihat

### 2. jenazah.sg (Bereavement Guidance)
- **Summary:** Free funeral notices, a private family link, and step-by-step bereavement guides for Muslim families in Singapore. Families coordinate rites, mosque prayers, and bilingual WhatsApp notices without creating an account.
- **Website:** https://jenazah.sg
- **Walkthrough:** https://www.mustechgroup.com/portfolio#jenazah-deep-dive

### 3. TaraBase (Pre-Orders for Home-Based Businesses)
- **Summary:** Gives home-based businesses in Singapore their own Telegram shop, with daily order limits, PayNow payments straight to the seller's bank, and automatic receipt checks. Zero commission.
- **Website:** https://tarabase.co
- **Privacy Policy:** https://tarabase.co/privacy
- **Walkthrough:** https://www.mustechgroup.com/portfolio#tarabase-deep-dive

### 4. MusTech Jumpstart (Course for Founders)
- **Summary:** A hands-on course for founders. Participants receive ready-made skills, workspace folders, and templates, set them up in their own business, and learn to give AI tools clear jobs and check their work. Works with Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex.
- **Programme Page:** https://www.mustechgroup.com/jumpstart

## Tayyib Architecture (Our Values)
1. **Amanah (Trust):** We collect only what each product needs, and never sell it or advertise with it.
2. **Tijarah (Ethical Enterprise):** Zero marketplace commissions and no dark patterns.
3. **Mizan (Equilibrium):** Quiet tools that respect your time, with no endless feeds.
